title: Repository Intelligence Repository Context
description: Structural repository context for Repository Intelligence artifacts. This schema identifies declared repository context only; it is not Repository State and does not establish repository validity.

repository_path.description: Declared repository path or root identity when included by a governed artifact. This field is descriptive and does not establish Repository State.

repository_status_context.description: Declared status context when supplied by an artifact producer. This field is descriptive and does not establish lifecycle or Repository State validity.
